article.headline: Milan rally to win at Olympiacos to kick-start UEL campaign
article.description: AC Milan produced a second-half fightback from 2-0 down to beat Olympiacos 4-2 in Piraeus and kick-start their Europa League campaign.
article.linkText: Milan rally to win at Olympiacos to kick-start UEL campaign
article.story:
AC Milan produced a second-half fightback from 2-0 down to beat Olympiacos 4-2 in Piraeus and kick-start their Europa League campaign.

After a low-key start at the Stadio Georgios Karaiskakis, Olympiacos broke the deadlock from a corner in the 31st minute.

Former Inter defender Lorenzo Pirola crashed a header against the crossbar and the ball bounced back into the net off Mike Maignan's arm.

Milan -- who had lost three of their four previous Europa League games -- were close to a swift equalizer in the 35th minute.

Alphadjo Cissè raced onto a through pass as Olympiacos keeper Stefan Ortega rushed out, and then stabbed the loose ball goalwards only for Pirola to hack it clear as he slid on into a post.

Pirola then missed a chance to double Olympiacos' lead in stoppage time at the end of the first half when he fired over from 10 yards.

Olympiacos, who were unbeaten in Europe with three wins, scored again four minutes into the second half.

Remo Freuler found Jota Silva at the edge of the penalty area and he fired the ball past Maignan into the top corner.

Milan got themselves back into the match trough a fine individual goal from Omari Hutchinson in the 56th minute.

The on-loan Nottingham Forest winger picked the ball up on the halfway line and burst down the right before cutting inside at the edge of the penalty area and rolling the ball into the far corner.

The Rossoneri struck again in the 63rd minute when Hutchinson sent over a floated cross from the right towards the back post where Cisse nodded the ball past Ortega.

Substitute Christian Pulisic completed the turnaround with 20 minutes left when he volleyed home a cross from the right after more quick footwork from Hutchinson.

Diego Moreira swept home a fourth in added time following a swift counter attack by Pulisic.
